command.text: declare @message nvarchar(4000) select @message = '' &VisibleFieldGridDetailShowing; select @message as message return

grid.response:
if exists(select 1 from dmtk where tk = @tk and loai_tk = 1) begin declare @$q nvarchar(4000), @$c_013 varchar(32), @$arAccount varchar(512), @$apAccount varchar(512), @$accKey nvarchar(4000)
select top 1 @$arAccount = rtrim(ltrim(val)) from options where name = 'm_tk_cn_pth' select top 1 @$apAccount = rtrim(ltrim(val)) from options where name = 'm_tk_cn_ptr' select top 1 @$c_013 = rtrim(ltrim(val)) from options where name = 'c_013'
select top 0 tk into #$ar from dmtk select top 0 tk into #$ap from dmtk
exec dbo.FastBusiness$App$GetAccountKey 'tk', 'inlist', @$arAccount, '#$ar', @@userID, @@admin, @$accKey output if isnull(@$c_013, '0') = '1' begin select @$q = 'insert into #$ar select tk from dmtk' + case when @$accKey is not null then ' where ' + @$accKey else '' end exec sp_executesql @$q end exec dbo.FastBusiness$App$GetAccountKey 'tk', 'inlist', @$apAccount, '#$ap', @@userID, @@admin, @$accKey output if isnull(@$c_013, '0') = '1' begin select @$q = 'insert into #$ap select tk from dmtk' + case when @$accKey is not null then ' where ' + @$accKey else '' end exec sp_executesql @$q end
select a.tk_cn, isnull(case when b.tk is not null then '1' when c.tk is not null then '2' else '0' end, '0') as kieu_tk from dmtk a left join #$ar b on a.tk = b.tk left join #$ap c on a.tk = c.tk where a.tk = @tk return end
declare @$u varchar(32), @$baseCurrency varchar(32), @$vNumber varchar(32), @$id varchar(32)
select top 1 @$baseCurrency = rtrim(ltrim(val)) from options where name = 'm_ma_nt0' select @$u = case when @$ma_dvcs <> '' then @$ma_dvcs else @@unit end, @$vNumber = dbo.ff_PadL(@so_ct_tt2, col_length('cttt30', 'so_ct'))
if exists(select 1 from cttt20 where ma_dvcs = @$u and (@ma_kh = '' or ma_kh = @ma_kh) and ngay_ct <= @$ngay_lct and loai_tt = 0 and stt_rec = @stt_rec_tt2 and so_ct = @$vNumber) select @$id = @stt_rec_tt2 else select top 1 @$id = stt_rec from cttt20 where ma_dvcs = @$u and (@ma_kh = '' or ma_kh = @ma_kh) and ngay_ct <= @$ngay_lct and loai_tt = 0 and (tat_toan = 0 or (stt_rec in (select stt_rec_tt from cttt20 where stt_rec = @$stt_rec and loai_tt = 1))) and so_ct = @$vNumber order by stt_rec
if @$id is not null begin select a.ngay_ct, case when a.ma_nt = '' then @$baseCurrency else a.ma_nt end as ma_nt from cttt20 a where a.stt_rec = @$id and (@ma_kh = '' or ma_kh = @ma_kh) and ngay_ct <= @$ngay_lct and (@$ma_nt = '' or a.ma_nt = @$ma_nt or (a.ma_nt = '' and @$ma_nt = @$baseCurrency)) and a.loai_tt = 0 and (tat_toan = 0 or (tat_toan = 1 and stt_rec in (select stt_rec_tt from cttt20 where stt_rec = @$stt_rec and loai_tt = 1))) and a.stt_rec = @$id and a.so_ct = @$vNumber end else select null as ngay_ct, '' as ma_nt return
declare @$u varchar(32), @$baseCurrency varchar(32), @$vNumber varchar(32), @$id varchar(32)
select top 1 @$baseCurrency = rtrim(ltrim(val)) from options where name = 'm_ma_nt0' select @$u = case when @$ma_dvcs <> '' then @$ma_dvcs else @@unit end, @$vNumber = dbo.ff_PadL(@so_ct_tt3, col_length('cttt30', 'so_ct'))
if exists(select 1 from cttt30 where ma_dvcs = @$u and (@ma_kh = '' or ma_kh = @ma_kh) and ngay_ct <= @$ngay_lct and loai_tt = 0 and stt_rec = @stt_rec_tt3 and so_ct = @$vNumber) select @$id = @stt_rec_tt3 else select top 1 @$id = stt_rec from cttt30 where ma_dvcs = @$u and (@ma_kh = '' or ma_kh = @ma_kh) and ngay_ct <= @$ngay_lct and loai_tt = 0 and (tat_toan = 0 or (stt_rec in (select stt_rec_tt from cttt30 where stt_rec = @$stt_rec and loai_tt = 1))) and so_ct = @$vNumber order by stt_rec
if @$id is not null begin select a.ngay_ct, case when a.ma_nt = '' then @$baseCurrency else a.ma_nt end as ma_nt from cttt30 a where a.stt_rec = @$id and (@ma_kh = '' or ma_kh = @ma_kh) and ngay_ct <= @$ngay_lct and (@$ma_nt = '' or a.ma_nt = @$ma_nt or (a.ma_nt = '' and @$ma_nt = @$baseCurrency)) and a.loai_tt = 0 and (tat_toan = 0 or (tat_toan = 1 and stt_rec in (select stt_rec_tt from cttt30 where stt_rec = @$stt_rec and loai_tt = 1))) and a.stt_rec = @$id and a.so_ct = @$vNumber end else select null as ngay_ct, '' as ma_nt return
&CreateTicket; select @ticket as value return
&ESG.XMLGridResponse;

query.text:
declare @$q nvarchar(4000), @$c_013 varchar(32), @$baseCurrency varchar(32), @$arAccount varchar(512), @$apAccount varchar(512), @$accKey nvarchar(4000)
select top 1 @$baseCurrency = rtrim(ltrim(val)) from options where name = 'm_ma_nt0' select top 1 @$arAccount = rtrim(ltrim(val)) from options where name = 'm_tk_cn_pth' select top 1 @$apAccount = rtrim(ltrim(val)) from options where name = 'm_tk_cn_ptr' select top 1 @$c_013 = rtrim(ltrim(val)) from options where name = 'c_013'
select top 1 @$baseCurrency = rtrim(ltrim(val)) from options where name = 'm_ma_nt0'
select stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_nt into #$cttt20 from cttt20 select stt_rec, ngay_ct, ma_nt into #$cttt30 from cttt30 select top 0 tk into #$ar from dmtk select top 0 tk into #$ap from dmtk
exec dbo.FastBusiness$App$GetAccountKey 'tk', 'inlist', @$arAccount, '#$ar', @@userID, @@admin, @$accKey output if isnull(@$c_013, '0') = '1' begin select @$q = 'insert into #$ar select tk from dmtk' + case when @$accKey is not null then ' where ' + @$accKey else '' end exec sp_executesql @$q end exec dbo.FastBusiness$App$GetAccountKey 'tk', 'inlist', @$apAccount, '#$ap', @@userID, @@admin, @$accKey output if isnull(@$c_013, '0') = '1' begin select @$q = 'insert into #$ap select tk from dmtk' + case when @$accKey is not null then ' where ' + @$accKey else '' end exec sp_executesql @$q end
select @@fieldExternal from @@prime$partition$current a left join dmtk b on a.tk = b.tk left join dmkh c on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh &ESG.queryLoadingHoverField; left join #$cttt20 d on a.stt_rec_tt2 = d.stt_rec left join #$cttt30 e on a.stt_rec_tt3 = e.stt_rec left join #$ar f on a.tk = f.tk left join #$ap g on a.tk = g.tk &ESG.queryLoading; where a.stt_rec = @stt_rec order by a.stt_rec, a.line_nbr
